title: 100 Common English Phrases for Daily Conversation | Listen and Repeat Practice
description:
100 common English phrases for daily conversation to listen to and repeat: starting a conversation, keeping it going, opinions, likes and dislikes, invitations, apologies, phone calls, health, time and weather, and ending a conversation. This is English speaking practice for every day, about 25 minutes long.

How to practice: listen to the phrase, say it out loud in the pause, then listen and say it again. After each part, you say all ten phrases once more. Every tenth phrase is a stronger or more natural way to say something simple, for example "It's freezing" instead of "It's very cold."

The 100 phrases

Starting a conversation
Hi there!
How have you been?
How's your day going?
What do you do?
Where are you from?
Do you live around here?
Nice weather today, isn't it?
Is this seat taken?
Do you come here often?
Couldn't be better!

Keeping it going
Really?
Tell me more.
That's interesting.
What happened next?
I see what you mean.
Me too.
Me neither.
No way!
Are you serious?
It's fascinating.

Opinions
What do you think?
In my opinion, it's a good idea.
I think so.
I don't think so.
It depends.
You have a point.
I'm not so sure about that.
That makes sense.
I see it differently.
I couldn't agree more.

Likes and dislikes
I love this song.
I'm into cooking.
I'm not a big fan of horror movies.
I can't stand traffic.
It's not my thing.
I prefer tea to coffee.
What kind of music do you like?
I'd rather stay home.
I really enjoyed it.
It's gorgeous.

Invitations and offers
Would you like a drink?
Do you want to grab a coffee?
Yes, I'd love to.
Sorry, I can't make it.
Maybe another time.
Let me get this.
Help yourself.
Make yourself at home.
After you.
Thank you so much.

Apologies and problems
I'm so sorry.
It was my fault.
I didn't mean to.
No problem.
It's okay.
Never mind.
Excuse me, I think there's a mistake.
It doesn't work.
I forgot.
It's terrible.

On the phone
Hello, who's calling?
Can I speak to Anna, please?
Hold on a second.
I'll call you back.
Can you hear me?
You're breaking up.
Sorry, wrong number.
I'll text you later.
Thanks for calling.
I have no clue.

Health
I don't feel well.
I have a headache.
I caught a cold.
I need to see a doctor.
Get well soon!
Take it easy.
I'm feeling better now.
I need some rest.
Are you okay?
I'm worn out.

Time and weather
What time is it?
It's three thirty.
What's the date today?
I'm in a hurry.
Take your time.
It's raining again.
It's getting dark.
What's the weather like?
It's a beautiful day.
It's freezing.

Ending a conversation
I have to go now.
It was great to see you.
Let's keep in touch.
Give me a call sometime.
Thanks for everything.
Good luck!
Have a great weekend!
Same to you!
See you soon.
See you later.
